Bug_Title: "equals" methods should be symmetric and work for subclasses
Bug_Explanation: The equals method in the Fruit class uses instanceof and a hardcoded class check that breaks the symmetry aspect of the equals contract. When checked against a subclass like Raspberry, fruit.equals(raspberry) returns true, but raspberry.equals(fruit) returns false.
Trigger_Explanation: The testSymmetryViolation method creates two objects, fruit and raspberry, with the same Season. The symmetry of the equals method is tested by asserting that both fruit.equals(raspberry) and raspberry.equals(fruit) should return true, but due to the bug in the equals method, this symmetry is broken and the test fails. testShowBugMethod checks the showBug method, which also demonstrates this asymmetry.
